steps.note: Open the Single Stage create screen.
Enable event creation for the test company.
Allow a vendor to be added during event creation.
Set the event type to RFQ.
Choose the first available RFQ template so the product sheet is available.
Add the requested product with quantity 10.
Set the requested delivery location in the product sheet.

args.goal: On the current single-stage create screen, remove the sample.pdf attachment using its delete control and stop with exactly sample.png still listed in the attachments area.

steps.note: Perform and verify the attachment removal, which has no dedicated domain step.
Add one available QA test vendor to the event.
Verify that publishing reached the real project page.
Verify that only the remaining attachment is listed on the project details page.
Open the invited vendor's supplier portal session.
Open the published event in the vendor's overview.
Verify that the remaining attachment is visible to the vendor.
